card.name: Conditional permission to adjust or repeat doses
card.fires_on: The word 'be' after 'may' (or a nearby comma or 'dose') in dosing instructions where an extra, repeated or increased dose is allowed if the response is inadequate.

modes.label: may be + action
modes.description: The word 'be' right after 'may' before a verb like administered, increased or given.
modes.example: the dose may<< be>> increased to 1 mg once daily.

modes.label: Condition then permission
modes.description: A comma or noun in an 'if not achieved, then...' clause that leads into permission to give more.
modes.example: After 2 days, if necessary<<,>> the dose can be increased to 0

modes.label: May repeat
modes.description: The verb right after 'May' in a short bullet permitting a repeat dose.
modes.example: • May<< repeat>> dose after 2 hours if needed;

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words meaning permitted or allowed.
card.plain: It marks spots in dosing text where the label says an extra or higher dose may be given if needed.
